_doc: Oathwild spell visuals for the Spell Kit (avatar-3d/spellkit/README.md has every field). visuals: id -> { label, kind (missile|ground|nova|beam|cone|melee|self|shift|summon|aura), school (palette + {school} in texture names), phases: windup / release / travel {speed, arc, count, every, from, layers} / impact / linger {seconds, radius, layers} / aura / beam {seconds, layers} / sweep }. Colours: hot | mid | deep | smoke | white | black (from the school palette) or '#rrggbb'. spells: Oathwild spell id -> visual id or { visual, school, scale } (written by avatar-3d/spellkit/tools/map-spells.mjs; hand changes go in its table). fallback: '<targetKind>:<element>' -> visual for spells added later. Look pass: 3 (avatar-3d/spellkit/tools/triple-visuals.mjs: ~3x every layer + point/area phases; 2026-11-26).

line_wave.label: Lance / wave along a line (any school)
